Hi team,

Amelia Wu (ex-Cloudflare, Staff SWE candidate) completed her screening call this morning and is excited to move to a full loop. Attaching her resume and a rough two-day agenda for panel sequencing. Goals: 1) keep each session no more than 50 minutes, 2) avoid scheduling across late evenings for Amelia (she's PST), 3) preserve a PM + EM + two technical deep dives + culture/IC fit.

Proposed window (PST / UTC):
- Day 1 morning: 09:30–11:00 PST (17:30–19:00 UTC) — PM interview + product/strategy case (30 + 40 mins)
- Day 1 afternoon: 13:00–14:30 PST (21:00–22:30 UTC) — Eng deep-dive A (50 mins) + short break
- Day 2 morning: 09:00–11:30 PST (17:00–19:30 UTC) — Eng deep-dive B (50 mins) + EM + hiring manager sync (50 mins)
- Day 2 afternoon: 13:30–14:30 PST — Culture / bar-raiser (45 mins) + buffer/feedback wrap (15 mins)

Constraints / ask:
- Laura, can you own PM slot and the product case?
- Marissa, can you cover Eng deep-dive A or nominate an alternate?
- Karthik, you’re the evaluator for tech B — confirm availability?
- Sean, can you close the schedule and send final calendar invites once we agree?

Attachments: Amelia_Wu_Resume.pdf, proposed_multi-slot_agenda_v1.docx

Thanks — Mina
